probes.freshMobileHeader: async(page)=>{await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await page.goto('https://dashboard.bex.co/env-groups');await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Search environment groups by name',exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:15000});await page.waitForTimeout(1200);const measure=()=>page.evaluate(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('main table'),rect=e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height}};return{width:innerWidth,docWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,table:rect(t),container:rect(t.parentElement),scrollWidth:t.parentElement.scrollWidth,headers:Array.from(t.querySelectorAll('th')).map(e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e);const chars=[];for(let j=0;j<(e.firstChild?.textContent||'').length;j++){const r=document.createRange();try{r.setStart(e.firstChild,j);r.setEnd(e.firstChild,j+1);const x=r.getBoundingClientRect();chars.push({char:e.firstChild.textContent[j],y:x.y,height:x.height})}catch{}}return{text:e.textContent,...rect(e),whiteSpace:s.whiteSpace,overflowWrap:s.overflowWrap,wordBreak:s.wordBreak,lineHeight:s.lineHeight,chars}})}});const initial=await measure();await page.locator('main [data-slot="table-container"]').evaluate(e=>e.scrollLeft=e.scrollWidth);await page.screenshot({path:'qa-a821-envgroups-mobile-right.png'});const afterScroll=await measure();return{at:new Date().toISOString(),initial,afterScroll};}

probes.localCssControl: async(page)=>{const measure=()=>page.evaluate(()=>({width:innerWidth,docWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,headers:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main table th')).map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return{text:e.textContent,width:r.width,height:r.height,whiteSpace:getComputedStyle(e).whiteSpace}}),container:{clientWidth:document.querySelector('main [data-slot="table-container"]').clientWidth,scrollWidth:document.querySelector('main [data-slot="table-container"]').scrollWidth}}));const before=await measure();const style=await page.addStyleTag({content:'main table thead th { white-space: nowrap; }'});try{return{at:new Date().toISOString(),before,localCssControl:await measure(),notDeployedFix:true}}finally{await style.evaluate(e=>e.remove())}}
